Mario Kart 64 World Records

Two datasets were used in this project. Dataset records contains the information of world records of racing game Mario Kart 64 on Nintendo 64, and drivers dataset is the information of player.

For more detail of datasets, please visit Mario Kart Dataset.

Recap

  • The overall trends of finish time decrease slightly as expected. Using shortcut for three laps could improve the time significantly, but it is abnormal that some records of three laps with shortcut is even faster than its single lap’s record.

  • The rank of total improvement time in track records is fairly consistent between single and three lap races, even in the face of the suspicious looking three lap races that include shortcuts.

  • Most of the longest standing records were beat by less than 0.10 seconds, with the exception of D.K. Jungle Parkway which was much higher.
